decision: P3.1 provides enough evidence of learnable input signal to begin LunarJEV; do not require more scratch runs, full acquisition, pretrained weights or performance profiling first.

new_hypotheses.J1: Do source-grounded public candidate descriptions improve closed-set decisions relative to class-ID controls?
new_hypotheses.J2: Does task/candidate-conditioned spatial querying improve over a same-description pooled semantic scorer?
new_hypotheses.J3: Can one observation encoding support Geology and Age Choice queries with measured cost and honest task-consistency evaluation?

data.sampling_scope: Availability-selected northern stored-split subset; no global, unseen-class or confirmatory test claim

context_encoder.source: P3.1 independently trained Geology scratch models
context_encoder.weights: best_state_dict verified against each existing run receipt; not last state_dict
context_encoder.global_control: Mean of the same cached spatial tokens

candidate_semantics.description_policy: Prefer already local, audited public geological definitions. Never invent them. If missing, implement with explicitly marked TAXONOMY_ONLY_LOCAL descriptions from symbols and the validated Age mapping; do not claim full geological-language evidence.
candidate_semantics.text_encoder_policy: One existing local verified frozen encoder, fixed before scores; if none, a separately labelled deterministic lexical TF-IDF control fitted only on public catalog/task text. No new weight download or paid API.
candidate_semantics.missing_semantic_assets_block: Only the full-semantic scientific claim, not context export, architecture implementation or explicitly weak-semantic controls

model.name: LunarJEV-lite Semantic Query Decider
model.implementation_kind: New proposed lightweight discriminative module; not a claimed RSJEV/Clef reproduction
model.onepass_scope: Reuse one observation context; parallel discriminative queries. No asserted speed advantage or arbitrary-language understanding.

comparison_matrix.name: ordinary
comparison_matrix.candidate_information: separate learned task outputs plus masked-softmax

comparison_matrix.name: pooled_semantic
comparison_matrix.candidate_information: same fixed descriptions and task representation as J

comparison_matrix.name: lunarjev_query
comparison_matrix.candidate_information: same fixed descriptions as B2, queried against spatial evidence

proposed_head_training_defaults.task_loss: Mean of Geology CE and Age CE; same two-task supervision for every comparison
proposed_head_training_defaults.selection: Strictly higher Val full-49 Geology Macro-F1; earliest tie. Report Age from the same selected checkpoint.
proposed_head_training_defaults.execution_requires: Versioned run manifest with actual cache, checkpoint, catalog, text-encoder and source hashes before new scores

evaluation.role: Exploratory development-set model comparison; existing Val was already used for selection
controls: one fixed correctly aligned vs consistently permuted description control
no_claims: candidate subset API proves semantic reasoning
validation success proves lunar landing safety

tasks.work: Read-only checkpoint validation and batched same-ID context-cache export
Candidate registry and one fixed text/taxonomy representation with truthful provenance
B0/B1/B2/J module interfaces, paired controls, unit tests and finite real-cache smoke
Four methods by three seeds on frozen caches; no backbone retraining
Report J1/J2/J3 support and failure modes without rewriting prior experiments
